thesis: This episode argues that SpaceX's valuation is driven by its potential to become a stop-gap network provider for carriers like T-Mobile and Verizon when their infrastructure fails, rather than just satellite internet competition. It also highlights the profitability of SpaceX's supply chain, noting that Lockheed Martin sells spacecraft components for significantly more than their raw material cost.
